audit_tooling: DataForSEO REST /v3/on_page/lighthouse/live/json (for_mobile=false) + /v3/on_page/instant_pages (enable_javascript, load_resources, validate_micromarkup); MCP on_page_lighthouse / on_page_instant_pages tools not exposed in this build
url_selection: auto-derived from plan/url-plan.json (no audit-urls.txt). Service landings: fire-damage-restoration and roofing (first two of four tied at priority 9.0, plan order). No url-plan service-area has primary: true; plan-input primary area pittsburgh-pa has no page (folded into home, /service-areas/pittsburgh-pa/ returns 404), so the first area slug was used: penn-hills-pa.
environment_caveats: SEO score inconclusive: staging noindex artifact (x-robots-tag: noindex on *.pages.dev, is-crawlable fails). SEO excluded from verdicts; re-audit after apex cutover.
Desktop-only Lighthouse (formFactor=desktop, cpuSlowdownMultiplier=1, throughputKbps=10240). Mobile scores typically 10-20 performance points lower.
Client record status is 'onboarding', not 'active'; audit proceeded because build_status is pushed_main and the staging preview is live.

Canonicals, og:url and JSON-LD point to https://katofskyconstruction.com, which currently resolves to 3.33.130.190 / 15.197.148.33 and fails the TLS handshake (curl exit 35). Correct for post-cutover, but canonicals point at a host that does not serve this build until apex cutover.
